chapter_mission: Ben and Talon cross storm-exposed gantries and sea-wall system while pursued. Ben protects people; Talon gets them to a skiff or shuttle. They escape Tarn Velos. The First Plot Point lands here: Ben has crossed a threshold he cannot uncross. He has broken cover, freed a convicted prisoner, generated a public crisis, and committed himself to the case in a way that makes returning to the way things were impossible. The forced partnership with Talon is the new condition of his life.
chapter_turn: They escape Tarn Velos, but the legal mess is now unavoidable.
